profile.name: Mahfuzur Rahman
profile.title: DevOps & Platform Engineer
profile.summary: 8+ years building and operating production platforms in banking and enterprise IT. Designed AppFlux — a 5-module internal platform (API gateway, CD, monitoring, logs, ops hub) on Kubernetes and Nutanix VMs. Open to remote and international roles.

paragraphs: Platform engineer at Jamuna Bank Limited — production Kubernetes on Nutanix, internal developer platform, API gateway, and full observability stack in a regulated on-premises environment.

highlights: Built AppFlux — 5-module platform (API gateway, deployment automation, monitoring, log management, ops hub) with live demos for internal teams
Operate production Kubernetes on Nutanix VMs — RBAC, Harbor registry, GitLab CI/CD, and Trivy image scanning
Delivered OpenResty API gateway with JWT auth, rate limiting, and real-time traffic observability for banking services
Automated webhook-driven deployments for .NET, Node.js, Python, and static apps — rollback, RBAC, and audit trails
Run centralized observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch) across infrastructure and production applications
Managed Linux and Windows servers across dev, staging, and production
Implemented monitoring, patching, and security hardening for business-critical systems
Supported CI/CD adoption and deployment standardization with development teams
Administered Linux/Windows hosting — VPS, dedicated servers, DNS, and SSL/TLS
Automated server tasks with Bash, Python, and PowerShell
Resolved infrastructure and customer-facing hosting issues with proactive maintenance
